node.statement: Under the extra hypothesis explicitly stated in amended node 1.3, choose a contour Gamma in the common functional-calculus domain enclosing the relevant spectrum. Since iota_n is a unital algebra homomorphism for composition, (lambda 1-iota_n(T)) iota_n((lambda 1-T)^{-1})=iota_n((lambda 1-T)(lambda 1-T)^{-1})=1, and likewise in the opposite order. Thus (lambda 1-iota_n(T))^{-1}=iota_n((lambda 1-T)^{-1}) for lambda in Gamma.
